first_sync_attempt.result: no new rows; app handshake and dataset binding succeeded
first_sync_attempt.cause: app was reinstalled with a fresh local state but reused the existing collector epoch, so its newly generated stream IDs collided with the server's existing stream identities
first_sync_attempt.repair: restored the 11 existing server stream IDs, last_client_seq+1 and last_batch_id into the app's local RAIV2Sync/state.json; cleared failed pages; relaunched app

second_sync_attempt.result: all events unchanged; no new fact rows

rate_limit.cause: client produced 79 empty Workout batches in addition to 13 duplicate batches; the shared write/upload budgets were exhausted

empty_page_fix.change: when a full Workout page has no events, supplements or deletions, persist candidateAnchor with finishEmptyPage instead of sealing an empty batch

live_ingestion.conclusion: actual HealthKit heart-rate samples are being inserted; the visible 429 is the intended 30 uploads/min device budget, not a stalled sync

rate_limit_override.mechanism: RAI_RATE_BUDGETS deployment JSON override; defaults unchanged when unset

relaxed_rate_sync_observation.conclusion: relaxed budgets no longer produce device_rate_exceeded; ingestion reached 118410 samples, 17 routes and 415 associations. The client then stopped making server requests while 36 association pages were parked as association_unavailable; app restart released the client wait without changing server facts. A further foreground sync is required to resume the bounded import.

client_changes: quantity page walk limit increased from 8 to 500 pages per stream per foreground pass
association pages are paused while any supported quantity stream is still incomplete; no 409 retry storm during sample catch-up
idle timer disabled during sync so HealthKit reads are not suspended by screen lock

observed_client_stall.note: the client waited in a HealthKit/background phase; app relaunched at 16:15:10 with local state preserved

speed_optimization_2026_10_31.conclusion: rate limits are not the current bottleneck. The main wasted time was repeated association 409 retries and the eight-page per-pass cap. The optimized build is installed; one more foreground sync is required to measure end-to-end throughput. If the client stalls again without server requests, add a bounded HealthKit read timeout before claiming completion.

series_parallelization_2026_10_31.root_cause: a single quantity page can contain hundreds of multi-point HKQuantitySamples; each series is registration + chunk + seal. The old pipeline sent all operations one at a time, so a 909-operation HeartRate page blocked for many minutes.
changes: series registration/chunk/seal groups for distinct samples execute with bounded concurrency 8
the page cursor and receipts are committed once after the whole series tail succeeds; failures replay idempotently
series_parallelization_2026_10_31.conclusion: the parallel series drain completed the previously stalled HeartRate page and moved 159 series in about 20 seconds. The app is idle with 34 parked association pages; one more foreground tap is required to continue the remaining quantity pages.

latest_observation.note: series tail is advancing at roughly 3.5 samples/second with 8-way bounded concurrency; the server is responding and the client has no stalled network request.
